Problem.Description: Municipal grids waste 12-18% of generated power through legacy load balancing.
Problem.TargetAudience: Mid-size European municipalities and regional utilities
Problem.ExistingSolutions: Manual SCADA tuning and yearly grid audits

Solution.Description: Real-time load forecasting and automated grid balancing across substations.
Solution.Differentiation: Edge-deployed model that runs offline; no telemetry leaves the substation.
Solution.Benefits: Cuts losses by 6-9 pts, pays back in 14 months for a 50k-meter network.
Solution.Vision: Make every European municipality net-energy-positive by 2032.

Market.MarketSize: EUR 2.1B addressable across EU mid-tier utilities

BusinessModel.Pricing: EUR 0.04 per meter per month, annual contract

Operations.Requirements: Edge devices certified to IEC 61850, 24/7 NOC, ISO 27001 plan
Operations.ProtoType: Two pilots running in Lyon and Porto

Roadmap.Days30: Close third pilot, harden edge OTA pipeline
Roadmap.Days90: ISO 27001 audit kick-off, hire 2 grid engineers

FounderIdentity.Motivation: Built grids for a decade; saw the same 15% loss everywhere.

Problem.Description: Post-discharge patients miss 40% of vitals checks, driving readmissions.
Problem.ExistingSolutions: Phone follow-ups and consumer wearables not cleared for clinical use

Solution.Description: Class-IIa wearable streaming continuous ECG + SpO2 to a hospital dashboard.
Solution.Differentiation: FDA + CE cleared, 14-day battery, automated triage alerts
Solution.Benefits: Cuts 30-day readmission by 22% in two pilots.

FounderIdentity.Motivation: Lost a parent to a missed post-discharge arrhythmia.

Problem.Description: EU SMBs spend 6-9 weeks per year just keeping up with regulatory changes.
Problem.TargetAudience: Owner-operated SMBs (10-200 employees) in regulated trades
Problem.ExistingSolutions: Outsourced compliance firms (EUR 15-40k/yr) or DIY spreadsheets

Solution.Description: SaaS that monitors regulatory changes, maps them to the customer's business, and produces filing-ready packets.
Solution.Differentiation: Retrieval-grounded summaries with cite-back to source statutes; deterministic backend, no hallucinated obligations.
Solution.Benefits: Cuts compliance overhead from 9 wk/yr to 2 wk/yr at one-fifth the cost.
Solution.Vision: Regulatory compliance as a background utility, not a quarterly fire drill.

Market.PrimaryCustomer: Regulated SMBs in food, fintech-light, and trades
Market.BuyingBehavior: Self-serve trial, owner-operator decides in 2 weeks

Operations.Requirements: Statutes ingestion pipeline, 2 compliance editors on retainer

Roadmap.Days90: Hit EUR 200k ARR, hire 2 compliance editors

FounderIdentity.Motivation: Watched our last company waste a quarter on a single GDPR audit.

Problem.Description: EU consumer brands face mounting EPR fines for plastic packaging but have no scalable bio-alternative.
Problem.ExistingSolutions: Compostable PLA (limited scale) and recycled PET (still net-positive emissions)

Solution.Description: Mycelium-based rigid packaging that sequesters more CO2 than it emits, drop-in for existing fill lines.
Solution.Differentiation: Carbon-negative at scale; certified home-compostable in 8 weeks.
Solution.Benefits: Eliminates EPR fines, hits brand sustainability targets, lower unit cost than PLA at >1M units/yr.
Solution.Vision: Be the default rigid packaging substrate for European CPG by 2030.

BusinessModel.ProductOrService: Direct sale of moulded packaging units
BusinessModel.Pricing: EUR 0.14 per unit at 1M+ qty, scaling down to EUR 0.09

Operations.Requirements: Pilot factory in Brittany operational, 8 staff
Operations.ProtoType: Three CPG brands in qualification trials

Compliance.Certifications: EN 13432 in progress, TÜV OK Compost expected Q3

FounderIdentity.Motivation: EU packaging law was passed; somebody has to actually build the alternative.
